description_ar: 413 بطاقة: 125 بطاقة V17 الأصلية، إضافة إلى 288 ملف SVG أصلياً لمكتبة المطاعم والتلفاز؛ الحركة محفوظة فقط عندما تكون موجودة فعلياً في المصدر
accent_policy: Original static SVGs and native SMIL assets are preserved; generated motion wrappers never alter source artwork.

source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_3d_icons.zip: 79 concepts: 37 store and 42 TV icons, each with static and native SMIL animated SVG.
source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_launcher_ui_icons.zip: 16 launcher concepts with static, animated and focused states.
source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_launcher_ui_icons (1).zip: Byte-identical backup of the canonical launcher UI archive; verified and not duplicated.
source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_launcher_icons.zip: Four original orange/purple store and TV brand assets.
source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_launcher_icons (1).zip: Four alternate gold/blue store and TV brand assets.
source_archive_notes.ROYAL_Android_Icons_v2.zip: 22 matching original SVG and Android VectorDrawable XML pairs; subtle motion previews are generated without changing the original files.
source_archive_notes.restaurant_tv_icons_v2_transparent.zip: 288 original SVG icon files plus README and PLAYER_UI_DESCRIPTION.md. All paths and SVG bytes are preserved under packages/restaurant-tv-icons-v2-transparent/extracted/.
